The '''Kho Nai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kalamith sector/Legends|Kalamith sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kho Nai]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Khotta]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
